notes.title: Cosmetics Update
notes.content:
The price will double in the next update! This game will leave early access, with two new abilities implemented.

In the current update:


    New Achievements
    Cosmetics section in the shop, containing:
    Talon prints!
    A top hat!
    Dual wielding swords!
    An awesome cape!
    Dark trails for your sword!
    The mysterious cycling hues cosmetic!

notes.title: Abilities Update
notes.content:
Features:


    Complete quests and kill bosses/demons to earn Stabby Coins!
    Two abilities to purchase using Stabby Coins:
    Sprint 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32839385/950b6ab98aabc23a5e9725bd436bec1f3b4dcd5f.png
    Ghost 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32839385/aba7012502f3c652ac52bc0352641250f80e82a6.png


Each boss/demon drops 50 more coins than the last, so survive for longer to earn huge amounts! (the first boss drops 50)

notes.title: Demons Update
notes.content:
The Demons Update is now live!


    Custom key bindings
    New reward screen for when you beat your high score - NOW CONTAINS FIREWORKS
    Demons game mode (demons are very dangerous)


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32839385/923da02e08b52df91830edce91b38212292b5d6e.png


The next update will contain two abilities to buy in the shop! Release is estimated to be next week.
